notes: Changing body type and clothes is avatar customization, so this is Roleplay & Avatar Sim and the user's own words put it on Dress Up. I substituted settlement-static for the preset's stage-runway because the answers rule out any runway or judging and ask for pure free roam, and settlement-static is exactly a fixed pre-built place where personalization happens through the avatar rather than through property; I kept both preset options and added path-street so there is circulation to explore. I rejected interior-single because walk around and explore reads as more than one enclosed room, and with no user to ask I treated the boutiques as open storefronts, which keeps this on P0 instead of the P3 this genre usually carries. No option covers the body-morph and clothing stations themselves, so they should be placed inside the boutique frontages the layout produces.
